hooks.text: 跑跳冲刺绕到虫群侧面，以高速机动同时规避伤害和抢占位置
hooks.excerpt: Use your exceptional mobility to run, jump and dash around your enemies to avoid damage and to gain positional advantage.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 每次下潜都重组蚁丘生态，生物群系、陷阱、敌人与战利品同步变化
hooks.excerpt: Explore procedurally generated levels of the mysterious ant hill, with various diverse biomes with their own unique enemies, traps and loot. No run will be the same, as each adventure into the ant hill provides you with new challenges and opportunities.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 局间用宝石添置基地家具，为未来每次下潜预先争取优势
hooks.excerpt: Spend gems between runs to upgrade your base with furniture that gives you a nice little head start for your future runs.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
